recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中兩顆巨大的巨核細胞，細胞質豐富成熟，細胞核高度分葉並呈鹿角狀（staghorn）堆疊；這種大型、過度分葉的成熟巨核細胞是本態性血小板增多症（ET）的特徵。
features: Two very large megakaryocytes, many times the size of surrounding cells
Abundant mature, finely granular pale purple cytoplasm
No hypolobated, small or bare-nuclei dysplastic forms in this field
Background of maturing hematopoietic cells and red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large megakaryocytes with abundant mature granular cytoplasm and markedly hyperlobulated, deeply folded 'staghorn' nuclei. Surrounding hematopoietic cells show maturing lymphoid, granulocytic and erythroid elements without increased blasts in this field. Large, mature, hyperlobulated megakaryocytes are the characteristic morphologic finding of essential thrombocythemia. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical context (sustained thrombocytosis, JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, exclusion of reactive causes and other myeloid neoplasms).

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like hypolobated nuclei and high N:C ratio, forming dense clusters, rather than mature staghorn forms.
PV shows pleomorphic megakaryocytes of variable size with panmyelosis and elevated hemoglobin, not predominantly giant hyperlobated forms.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normal in size and lobation without the giant staghorn morphology.
5q- syndrome shows small, hypolobated or monolobated megakaryocytes rather than hyperlobated giant forms.
